title: Supervised Contrastive Learning of Environment-Invariant Representations
abstract: arXiv:2502.07281v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Real-world datasets often combine data collected under different experimental conditions. This yields larger datasets, but can also introduce environment-associated correlations that make it difficult to model the phenomena of interest. We address this with Supervised Contrastive Invariance Learning (SCIL), which learns a task-supervised representation $z_c$ while regularizing its environment-related structure, together with an environment-supervised auxiliary representation $z_s$. The contribution of the auxiliary representation to the reported results remains unresolved. SCIL is based purely on Supervised Contrastive Learning and uses a single hyperparameter $\alpha$ to control the strength of environment regularization. We study this regularization under distribution shift with Colored MNIST and Camelyon17-WILDS, where increasing $\alpha$ decreases in-distribution validation accuracy and increases held-out test accuracy. translated_title: 环境不变表示的监督对比学习
translated_abstract: 真实世界的数据集往往融合了在不同实验条件下收集的数据。这虽然带来了更大的数据集，但也可能引入与环境相关的关联性，使得对感兴趣现象的建模变得困难。我们提出了监督对比不变性学习（SCIL）来解决这一问题，该方法在学习任务监督的表示 $z_c$ 的同时，对其环境相关结构进行正则化，并结合一个环境监督的辅助表示 $z_s$。辅助表示对所报告结果的贡献仍有待厘清。SCIL 纯粹基于监督对比学习，仅使用一个超参数 $\alpha$ 来控制环境正则化的强度。我们在分布偏移场景下，使用 Colored MNIST 和 Camelyon17-WILDS 数据集研究了这种正则化，发现增大 $\alpha$ 会降低分布内验证准确率，同时提高留出测试准确率。
tldr: 提出监督对比不变性学习（SCIL），通过单一超参数控制环境正则化强度，在学习任务监督表示的同时抑制环境相关结构，从而在分布偏移下提升模型的泛化能力。
